new_words.english_meaning: The outline of a city's buildings and other structures when viewed from a distance.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દૂરથી જોતાં શહેરના મકાનો અને અન્ય રચનાઓની રેખાચિત્ર.
new_words.usage_note: The term 'skyline' is often used to describe the visual appearance of a city.
new_words.memory_tip: 'sky' = આભ થી 'line' = રેખા -> આભની રેખા એટલે સ્કાયલાઇન
examples: The city's skyline is dominated by the skyscraper.
The skyline of the city is very beautiful.
The skyline view from the top of the hill is amazing.
The skyline of the city has changed a lot in recent years.

new_words.english_meaning: An open area in a town or city, often surrounded by buildings and used for public gatherings.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: શહેરમાં ખુલ્લી જગ્યા, ઘણીવાર ઇમારતોથી ઘેરાયેલી અને જાહેર સમારોહ માટે વપરાય છે.
new_words.usage_note: A plaza is often used as a meeting place for people.
examples: The plaza is a popular spot for street performers.
The city's main plaza is surrounded by historic buildings.
The plaza is a great place to people-watch.
The new plaza in the city is very modern and beautiful.

new_words.english_meaning: The area where a city or town meets a body of water, such as a river, lake, or sea.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર અથવા નગર જ્યાં પાણીના સ્ત્રોત સાથે મળે છે, જેમકે નદી, તળાવ અથવા સમુદ્ર.
new_words.usage_note: The waterfront is often a popular area for recreation and tourism.
new_words.memory_tip: 'water' = પાણી અને 'front' = આગળ -> પાણીનો આગળનો ભાગ એટલે વોટરફ્રન્ટ
examples: The city's waterfront is a popular spot for walking and cycling.
The waterfront area is being redeveloped with new shops and restaurants.
The waterfront view from the hotel room is stunning.
The waterfront park is a great place for a picnic.

new_words.english_meaning: A notable or famous building, monument, or other structure that is easily recognizable.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક નોંધપાત્ર અથવા પ્રખ્યાત ઇમારત, સ્મારક અથવા અન્ય રચના જે સરળતાથી ઓળખી શકાય છે.
new_words.usage_note: Landmarks are often used as navigational aids.
new_words.memory_tip: 'land' = જમીન અને 'mark' = ચિહ્ન -> જમીનનું ચિહ્ન એટલે લેન્ડમાર્ક
examples: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
The city's landmark building is the town hall.
The landmark monument is a symbol of the city's history.
The landmark hotel is a popular spot for tourists.

new_words.english_meaning: A person who is walking, especially in a town or city.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ જે ચાલી રહ્યો છે, ખાસ કરીને શહેર અથવા નગરમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Pedestrians often have to be careful when crossing roads.
new_words.memory_tip: 'ped' = પગ અને 'estrian' = ચાલનાર -> પગથી ચાલનાર એટલે પેડેસ્ટ્રિયન
examples: The pedestrian crossed the road carefully.
The city has a pedestrian zone in the center.
The pedestrian bridge is a popular spot for walking.
The pedestrian traffic is very heavy during rush hour.

new_words.english_meaning: A road or path that passes under another road or railway.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક રસ્તો અથવા માર્ગ જે અન્ય રસ્તો અથવા રેલ્વે નીચેથી પસાર થાય છે.
new_words.usage_note: Underpasses are often used to reduce traffic congestion.
new_words.memory_tip: 'under' = નીચે અને 'pass' = પસાર થવું -> નીચેથી પસાર થવું એટલે અંડરપાસ
examples: The underpass is a convenient way to cross the busy road.
The city has several underpasses to reduce traffic congestion.
The underpass is a popular spot for street artists.
The underpass is well-lit and safe for pedestrians.

new_words.english_meaning: A circular intersection where traffic flows continuously in one direction.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક વર્તુળાકાર છેડા જ્યાં ટ્રાફિક એક દિશામાં સતત વહે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Roundabouts are often used to reduce traffic congestion and improve safety.
new_words.memory_tip: 'round' = વર્તુળ અને 'about' = આસપાસ -> વર્તુળમાં આસપાસ ફરવું એટલે રાઉન્ડઅબાઉટ
examples: The roundabout is a busy intersection in the city.
The roundabout is a great way to reduce traffic congestion.
The roundabout is a popular spot for street performers.
The roundabout is well-designed and safe for drivers.

new_words.english_meaning: A wide, tree-lined street, often in a city or town.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક પહોળો, વૃક્ષોથી ઘેરાયેલો રસ્તો, ઘણીવાર શહેર અથવા નગરમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Boulevards are often used for recreational purposes.
new_words.memory_tip: 'bou' = પહોળો અને 'levard' = રસ્તો -> પહોળો રસ્તો એટલે બુલેવર્ડ
examples: The boulevard is a popular spot for walking and cycling.
The city's main boulevard is lined with trees and shops.
The boulevard is a great place for a leisurely stroll.
The boulevard is well-lit and safe at night.

new_words.english_meaning: A wide, landscaped road, often in a park or other scenic area.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક પહોળો, દૃશ્યાત્મક રસ્તો, ઘણીવાર ઉદ્યાન અથવા અન્ય દૃશ્યાત્મક વિસ્તારમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Parkways are often used for recreational driving.
new_words.memory_tip: 'park' = ઉદ્યાન અને 'way' = રસ્તો -> ઉદ્યાનનો રસ્તો એટલે પાર્કવે
examples: The parkway is a popular spot for Sunday drives.
The city's parkway is lined with trees and gardens.
The parkway is a great place for a leisurely drive.
The parkway is well-maintained and safe for drivers.

new_words.english_meaning: An entrance or a point of access to a city, town, or other area.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રવેશદ્વાર અથવા શહેર, નગર અથવા અન્ય વિસ્તારમાં પ્રવેશ કરવાનું સ્થાન.
new_words.usage_note: Gateways are often used to mark the entrance to a city or town.
new_words.memory_tip: 'gate' = દરવાજો અને 'way' = રસ્તો -> દરવાજોથી રસ્તો એટલે ગેટવે
examples: The gateway to the city is a beautiful arch.
The town's gateway is marked by a sign.
The gateway is a popular spot for tourists.
The gateway is well-designed and safe for pedestrians.

new_words.english_meaning: The front of a building, especially a large or impressive one.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતનો સામેનો ભાગ, ખાસ કરીને મોટી અથવા આકર્ષક ઇમારત.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe the front of a building.
examples: The building's facade was designed by a famous architect.
The old facade of the church was restored to its original state.
The hotel's facade was covered in ivy and looked very picturesque.
The company's new headquarters has a striking facade made of glass and steel.

new_words.english_meaning: A window that projects from a sloping roof.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઢાળવાળી છત પરથી આગળ નીકળેલું બારી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a type of window.
examples: The attic room had a dormer window with a beautiful view of the city.
The old house had several dormers that let in plenty of natural light.
The dormer on the roof was designed to provide more space in the attic.
The architect included a dormer in the design to add visual interest to the facade.

new_words.english_meaning: The underside of a roof or a bridge, especially the part that is visible from below.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: છત અથવા પુલની નીચેની બાજુ, ખાસ કરીને નીચેથી જોઈ શકાય તે ભાગ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The soffit of the roof was made of wood and needed to be replaced.
The soffit of the bridge was covered in rust and needed to be repaired.
The architect designed the soffit to be visible from the street.
The soffit ventilation system helped to reduce the risk of moisture damage.

new_words.english_meaning: A horizontal beam that spans an opening, such as a door or window.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દરવાજા અથવા બારી જેવી ખુલ્લી જગ્યા પર આડી રીતે પથરાયેલો બાળુ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The lintel above the door was carved with intricate designs.
The lintel beam was made of steel and supported the weight of the wall.
The architect designed the lintel to be decorative as well as functional.
The lintel was damaged in the earthquake and needed to be replaced.

new_words.english_meaning: A vertical bar that divides a window or a door into separate sections.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: બારી અથવા દરવાજાને અલગ અલગ ભાગોમાં વિભાજિત કરતો ઉભો બારી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The mullions on the window were made of wood and added a touch of elegance.
The mullion on the door was decorative and served no functional purpose.
The architect designed the mullions to be thin and unobtrusive.
The mullions were removed to create a more open and airy feel in the room.

new_words.english_meaning: A wall or barrier that is built along the edge of a roof, bridge, or other structure.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: છત, પુલ અથવા અન્ય રચનાની ધાર પર બાંધવામાં આવેલી દિવાલ અથવા અવરોધ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
new_words.memory_tip: 'parapet' = ધારની દિવાલ -> છતની ધાર પર બાંધવામાં આવેલી દિવાલ
examples: The parapet on the roof was designed to prevent people from falling off.
The parapet on the bridge was made of stone and had a decorative railing.
The architect included a parapet in the design to add a sense of security.
The parapet was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

new_words.english_meaning: A rectangular column that is attached to a wall and projects slightly from it.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો અને થોડો બહાર નીકળેલો આયતાકાર સ્તંભ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
new_words.memory_tip: 'pilaster' = દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો સ્તંભ -> આયતાકાર સ્તંભ
examples: The pilasters on the wall were made of marble and added a touch of elegance.
The pilaster on the corner of the building was decorative and served no functional purpose.
The architect designed the pilasters to be thin and unobtrusive.
The pilasters were removed to create a more open and airy feel in the room.

new_words.english_meaning: A flat base or platform that supports a column, statue, or other structure.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સ્તંભ, મૂર્તિ અથવા અન્ય રચનાને આધાર આપતી સપાટ આધાર અથવા મંચ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The plinth of the statue was made of granite and had a decorative design.
The plinth of the column was cracked and needed to be repaired.
The architect designed the plinth to be strong and durable.
The plinth was covered in ivy and looked very picturesque.

new_words.english_meaning: A covered entrance to a building, typically with a roof and columns.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતનો ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર, સામાન્ય રીતે છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
new_words.memory_tip: 'portico' = ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર -> છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે
examples: The portico of the building was designed to be impressive and grand.
The portico was made of marble and had a decorative roof.
The architect included a portico in the design to add a sense of elegance.
The portico was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

new_words.english_meaning: A horizontal beam that spans an opening, such as a door or window, and is typically located above the lintel.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દરવાજા અથવા બારી જેવી ખુલ્લી જગ્યા પર આડી રીતે પથરાયેલો બાળુ, સામાન્ય રીતે લિન્ટેલની ઉપર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The transom above the door was made of wood and had a decorative design.
The transom window was opened to let in some fresh air.
The architect designed the transom to be strong and durable.
The transom was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

new_words.english_meaning: A planned route or journey, or a list of places to visit.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસનો આયોજિત માર્ગ અથવા મુસાફરી, અથવા મુલાકાત લેવાના સ્થળોની યાદી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or business contexts.
examples: The travel agent helped us create an itinerary for our trip to Europe.
The company's itinerary included meetings with several potential clients.
She spent hours planning the perfect itinerary for her honeymoon.
The tour group followed a strict itinerary to ensure they saw all the major sights.

new_words.english_meaning: The act of arriving at a hotel, airport, or other location and registering or announcing your presence.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: હોટલ, એરપોર્ટ અથવા અન્ય સ્થળે આગમન અને નોંધણી કરવી અથવા હાજરી જાહેર કરવી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The check-in time at the hotel is 3 pm.
She forgot to check-in for her flight and missed it.
The check-in process at the airport was very efficient.
The hotel offers online check-in to speed up the registration process.

new_words.english_meaning: The act of getting on a vehicle, such as a plane, train, or bus.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વાહન, જેમ કે વિમાન, ટ્રેન અથવા બસ, પર ચડવાની ક્રિયા.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The boarding process for the flight was very slow.
She forgot her boarding pass and had to go back to the check-in desk.
The boarding gate for the train is closing in 10 minutes.
The airline offers priority boarding for its premium passengers.

new_words.english_meaning: The act of leaving a place, such as a city, airport, or station.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ છોડવાની ક્રિયા, જેમ કે શહેર, એરપોર્ટ અથવા સ્ટેશન.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The departure time for the flight is 10 am.
The departure gate for the train is changing to platform 3.
The hotel offers a free shuttle service to the airport for departure.
The departure tax for international flights is very high.

new_words.english_meaning: The act of passing through a place, or a period of time spent traveling from one place to another.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળમાંથી પસાર થવાની ક્રિયા, અથવા એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો સમય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The transit time for the package was very long.
The transit visa for the country is required for all travelers.
The company offers a free transit service for its employees.
The transit system in the city is very efficient.

new_words.english_meaning: A way or course taken to get from one place to another.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો માર્ગ અથવા માર્ગ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The route to the airport is very congested.
The GPS suggested a new route to avoid traffic.
The company is changing its route to reduce costs.
The hikers got lost because they took a wrong route.

new_words.english_meaning: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા વસ્તુ જતા અથવા મોકલાતા સ્થળ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The destination of the flight was Paris.
The company's destination is to become the market leader.
The tourist's destination was the beach resort.
The package was sent to the wrong destination.

new_words.english_meaning: The act of traveling from one place to another.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવાની ક્રિયા.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The journey to the mountains was very tiring.
The company offers a journey planner to its employees.
The journey of the spaceship took several years.
The journey of life is full of ups and downs.

new_words.english_meaning: An official document that identifies a person as a citizen of a country and allows them to travel abroad.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશના નાગરિક તરીકે ઓળખે છે અને તેમને વિદેશમાં મુસાફરી કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She forgot her passport at home and couldn't travel.
The passport application process is very complicated.
The new passport has a biometric chip for added security.
The passport photo must be recent and clear.

new_words.english_meaning: An official document that gives someone permission to enter or stay in a country for a specific period of time.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશમાં પ્રવેશ કરવા અથવા રોકાણ કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She applied for a visa to study in the US.
The visa requirements for the country are very strict.
The visa fee for the tourist visa is very high.
The visa application process took several months.

new_words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of goods, including clothing, furniture, and household items.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ પ્રકારના વસ્ત્રો, ફર્નિચર અને ઘરેલુ સામાન વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store with multiple floors and a wide range of products.
new_words.memory_tip: 'depart' = અલગ થવું -> department store = વિવિધ વસ્તુઓનું સ્ટોર
examples: I'm going to the department store to buy a new shirt.
The department store is having a sale on all winter clothing.
She works at the department store in the cosmetics section.
The department store is open from 9 am to 9 pm.

new_words.english_meaning: A store that sells books, often with a wide selection of titles and genres.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: પુસ્તકો વેચતું સ્ટોર, ઘણીવાર વિવિધ શૈલીઓ અને વિષયોના પુસ્તકો હોય છે.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a store that specializes in selling books, as opposed to a general store that also sells books.
examples: I love spending hours in the bookshop, browsing through the shelves.
The bookshop is having a sale on all bestselling novels.
She works at the bookshop, helping customers find the perfect book.
The bookshop is a great place to attend author readings and signings.

new_words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of food and household products.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને ઘરેલુ ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store that sells a wide range of products, including fresh produce, meat, dairy products, and household essentials.
examples: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some milk and eggs.
The supermarket is having a sale on all organic products.
She works at the supermarket, restocking shelves and helping customers.
The supermarket is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

new_words.english_meaning: A place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the clothes that need to be washed.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કપડાં ધોવાનું સ્થળ, અથવા ધોવાના કપડાં.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the act of washing and cleaning clothes.
examples: I need to take my clothes to the laundry to get them cleaned.
The laundry is open from 8 am to 8 pm, 7 days a week.
She works at the laundry, washing and folding clothes all day.
The laundry service is very convenient, they pick up and deliver your clothes.

new_words.english_meaning: A room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને પીણાં પીરસવામાં આવતા ઓરડા અથવા ઇમારત, ઘણીવાર શાળા, હોસ્પિટલ અથવા ઓફિસ બિલ્ડિંગમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
examples: The cafeteria is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
I'm meeting my friends in the cafeteria to study for our exam.
She works in the cafeteria, serving food to students and staff.
The cafeteria has a variety of food options, including vegetarian and vegan dishes.

new_words.english_meaning: A person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ગહનાં બનાવતો, વેચતો અથવા સરવાળો કરતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ગહનાં વેચતું સ્ટોર.
collocations: get a piece appraised by a jeweler
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
examples: I'm going to the jeweler to get my ring resized.
The jeweler is having a sale on all diamond necklaces.
She works at the jeweler, helping customers find the perfect piece of jewelry.
The jeweler is known for its high-quality and unique designs.

new_words.english_meaning: A person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વાળ કાપતો, સ્ટાઇલ કરતો અને સંભાળતો વ્યક્તિ, ખાસ કરીને પુરુષો માટે, અથવા અવા સેવાઓ પૂરી પાડતું સ્થળ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
examples: I need to go to the barber to get a haircut.
The barber is very skilled and always gives a great shave.
She works at the barber shop, cutting and styling hair all day.
The barber shop is a great place to catch up on the latest sports news.

new_words.english_meaning: A person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ફૂલો વેચતો અને ગોઠવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ફૂલો અને અન્ય છોડ વેચતું સ્ટોર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
examples: I'm going to the florist to buy some flowers for my girlfriend.
The florist is having a sale on all roses and carnations.
She works at the florist, arranging and selling flowers all day.
The florist is known for its beautiful and unique arrangements.

new_words.english_meaning: A person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ચશ્માં અને કૉન્ટેક્ટ લેન્સ વેચતો અને પહેરાવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા અવા ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું સ્ટોર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
examples: I need to go to the optician to get my eyes checked.
The optician is having a sale on all designer glasses.
She works at the optician, helping customers choose the right frames.
The optician is known for its wide selection of contact lenses and solutions.

new_words.english_meaning: A company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: લોકોને પ્રવાસ, રજાઓ અને અન્ય પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરવામાં મદદ કરતી કંપની.
collocations: plan a trip with a travel agency
get travel advice from a travel agency
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
new_words.memory_tip: 'travel' = પ્રવાસ -> travel agency = પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરતી કંપની
examples: I'm going to the travel agency to book a flight to Paris.
The travel agency is having a sale on all package tours to Europe.
She works at the travel agency, helping customers plan their dream vacations.
The travel agency is known for its excellent customer service and competitive prices.

new_words.english_meaning: Peaceful and untroubled; calm and quiet.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: શાંતિપૂર્ણ અને અડચણરહિત; શાંત અને ખામોશ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe natural scenery or a peaceful atmosphere.
examples: The serene beauty of the lake made it a perfect spot for a picnic.
The hotel room had a serene view of the ocean.
The serene music helped me to relax.
The serene surroundings of the forest made me feel at peace.

new_words.english_meaning: Simple and unsophisticated; relating to the countryside.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સરળ અને અસંસ્કારી; ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe traditional or countryside-related things.
examples: The rustic cabin was a great place to spend the weekend.
The restaurant had a rustic atmosphere with wooden tables and chairs.
The rustic road was difficult to drive on.
The rustic village was surrounded by beautiful countryside.

new_words.english_meaning: Relating to the countryside; pastoral.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ; ચરાઈ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe idyllic or peaceful countryside scenes.
examples: The bucolic scenery of the rolling hills and green pastures was breathtaking.
The bucolic life of the village was far removed from the hustle and bustle of the city.
The bucolic atmosphere of the countryside was perfect for a relaxing vacation.
The bucolic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

new_words.english_meaning: Having a mixture of different cultures and ethnic groups; international.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ સંસ્કૃતિઓ અને જાતિય જૂથોનું મિશ્રણ; આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe cities or societies with a diverse population.
examples: The cosmopolitan city of New York has people from all over the world.
The cosmopolitan culture of the university was reflected in its diverse student body.
The cosmopolitan society of the city was tolerant of different lifestyles.
The cosmopolitan atmosphere of the restaurant was enhanced by its international cuisine.

new_words.english_meaning: Extremely happy or peaceful; highly pleasing.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સુખી અથવા શાંત; ખૂબ જ રૂચિકર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a highly pleasing or peaceful situation.
examples: The idyllic scenery of the beach made it a perfect spot for a romantic getaway.
The idyllic life of the village was far removed from the stress of the city.
The idyllic atmosphere of the garden was perfect for a relaxing afternoon.
The idyllic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

new_words.english_meaning: Growing thickly and healthily; rich and luxurious.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ગાઢ અને સ્વસ્થ રીતે વધતું; સમૃદ્ધ અને વિલાસિત.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe plants or natural scenery.
examples: The lush greenery of the forest was a sight to behold.
The lush gardens of the palace were famous for their beauty.
The lush vegetation of the island was home to a wide variety of wildlife.
The lush landscape of the painting depicted a thriving ecosystem.

new_words.english_meaning: Impressively beautiful or dignified; grand.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રભાવશાળી રીતે સુંદર અથવા ગંભીર; મહાન.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that inspires awe or admiration.
examples: The majestic scenery of the Grand Canyon was breathtaking.
The majestic architecture of the palace was a testament to its rich history.
The majestic mountains of the Himalayas were a challenge to climb.
The majestic landscape of the painting depicted a powerful and awe-inspiring scene.

new_words.english_meaning: Harsh or extreme; strict or stern.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કઠોર અથવા અતિશય; કડક અથવા સખત.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is harsh or extreme.
examples: The severe weather warning was issued for the entire state.
The severe punishment for the crime was a deterrent to others.
The severe critic of the movie was not impressed by its plot.
The severe landscape of the desert was unforgiving to travelers.

new_words.english_meaning: Extremely good or impressive; worthy of attention.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સારું અથવા પ્રભાવશાળી; ધ્યાન આપવા યોગ્ય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is impressive or attention-grabbing.
examples: The spectacular scenery of the fireworks display was enjoyed by all.
The spectacular performance of the musician was applauded by the audience.
The spectacular architecture of the building was a marvel of engineering.
The spectacular landscape of the painting depicted a vibrant and dynamic scene.

new_words.english_meaning: Full of energy and life; bright and colorful.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઊર્જાસભર અને જીવંત; તેજસ્વી અને રંગબેરંગી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is full of energy or life.
examples: The vibrant colors of the painting made it stand out.
The vibrant music of the festival was enjoyed by all.
The vibrant atmosphere of the city was infectious.
The vibrant landscape of the garden was full of life and color.

new_words.english_meaning: Near or close to a place
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in the vicinity of the city
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to a place
examples: The hotel is in the vicinity of the airport
There are several restaurants in the vicinity
The new school is in the vicinity of our house
The police station is in the vicinity of the city center

new_words.english_meaning: At the edge or boundary of a town or city
new_words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર અથવા નગરની સીમા પર
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the edge or boundary of a town or city
examples: The new shopping mall is on the outskirts of the city
The factory is located on the outskirts of town
The hotel is on the outskirts of the airport
The university is on the outskirts of the city center

new_words.english_meaning: In the center or middle of something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના મધ્યમાં અથવા વચ્ચે
collocations: in the middle of the city
in the middle of the night
in the middle of the forest
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located in the center or middle of something
examples: The park is in the middle of the city
The hotel is in the middle of the town
The restaurant is in the middle of the forest
The university is in the middle of the city center

new_words.english_meaning: At the base or bottom of something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના પાયા અથવા તળિયે
collocations: at the foot of the mountain
at the foot of the hill
at the foot of the statue
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the base or bottom of something
examples: The village is at the foot of the mountain
The hotel is at the foot of the hill
The monument is at the foot of the statue
The city is at the foot of the valley

new_words.english_meaning: Next to or adjacent to something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની બાજુમાં અથવા પાસે

by the side of the river
by the side of the house
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located next to or adjacent to something
examples: The park is by the side of the road
The hotel is by the side of the river
The restaurant is by the side of the house
The university is by the side of the city center

new_words.english_meaning: On the opposite side of something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની સામેની બાજુએ

The library is across from the bookstore

new_words.english_meaning: On the other side of something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની વિરુદ્ધ બાજુએ
collocations: on the opposite side of the street
on the opposite side of the room
on the opposite side of the table
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located on the other side of something

new_words.english_meaning: At a short distance away
new_words.gujarati_meaning: નજીકમાં અથવા આસપાસ
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is at a short distance away
examples: There is a shop nearby

The university is nearby

new_words.english_meaning: Near or close to something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in close proximity to the city
in close proximity to the airport

new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to something
examples: The hotel is in close proximity to the airport

new_words.english_meaning: Close enough to hear something
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક સાંભળવા માટે પૂરતી નજીક
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is close enough to hear something

The library is within earshot of the bookstore
